sentences.en: I never really planned to be a lifeboat volunteer when I came to live in Northsea.
sentences.zh: 我搬到北海镇居住时，从未真正计划过要成为一名救生艇志愿者。

sentences.en: I'd been working in London as a website designer, but although that was interesting, I didn't like city life.
sentences.zh: 我之前在伦敦做网站设计师，虽然这份工作很有趣，但我不喜欢城市生活。

sentences.en: I'd been really keen on boats as a teenager, and I thought if I went to live by the sea, I might be able to pursue that interest a bit more in my free time.
sentences.zh: 青少年时期我就对船只非常着迷，心想如果搬到海边居住，或许能在闲暇时间更深入地发展这一兴趣。

sentences.en: Then I found that the Lifeboat Institution was looking for volunteers, SO decided to apply.
sentences.zh: 后来我发现皇家全国救生艇协会正在招募志愿者，于是决定申请。

sentences.en: The Lifeboat Institution building here in Northsea's hard to miss, it's one of the largest in the country.
sentences.zh: 北海镇的皇家全国救生艇协会大楼非常醒目，是全国规模最大的几座之一。

sentences.en: It was built 15 years ago with funds provided by a generous member of the public who'd lived here all her life.
sentences.zh: 这座大楼建于15年前，资金来自一位毕生居住于此的热心公众人士的慷慨捐赠。

sentences.en: As the Lifeboat Institution is a charity that relies on that kind of donation, rather than funding provided by the government, that was a huge help to us.
sentences.zh: 由于皇家全国救生艇协会是一家依靠此类捐赠而非政府拨款运营的慈善机构，这笔捐助对我们而言帮助巨大。

sentences.en: When applied, had to have a health a assessment.
sentences.zh: 我申请时必须接受健康评估。

sentences.en: The doctors were particularly interested in my vision.
sentences.zh: 医生尤其关注我的视力状况。

sentences.en: I used to be short-sighted, so I'd had to wear glasses, but I'd had laser eye surgery two years earlier so that was OK.
sentences.zh: 我过去有近视，因此一直佩戴眼镜，但两年前已接受激光矫正手术，所以视力没有问题。

sentences.en: They gave me tests for colour blindness and they thought I might have a problem there, but it turned out I was OK.
sentences.zh: 他们为我做了色盲测试，起初怀疑我可能存在这方面问题，但最终结果显示一切正常。

sentences.en: When the coastguard gets an alert, all the volunteers are contacted and rush to the lifeboat station.
sentences.zh: 当海岸警卫队发出警报时，所有志愿者都会立即接到通知，并迅速赶往救生艇站。

sentences.en: Our target's to get there in five minutes, then we try to get the boat off the dock and out to sea in another six to eight minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是在五分钟内抵达站点，随后再用六至八分钟将救生艇驶离码头、开赴海上。

sentences.en: Our team's proud that we usually achieve that - the average time across the country's eight and a half minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们团队为此深感自豪——通常都能达成这一目标；而全国平均水平为八分半钟。

sentences.en: I've recently qualified as a what's called a 'helmsman', which means I have the ultimate responsibility for the lifeboat.
sentences.zh: 我最近取得了‘舵手’资格，这意味着我对救生艇负有最终责任。

sentences.en: I have to check that the equipment we use is in working order - the crew have special life jackets that can support up to four people in the water.
sentences.zh: 我必须检查所用设备是否处于正常工作状态——船员配备有特殊救生衣，可在水中支撑最多四人。

sentences.en: And it's ultimately my decision whether it's safe to launch the boat.
sentences.zh: 最终是否安全出航的决定权也在我手中。

sentences.en: But it's very rare not to launch it, even in the worst weather.
sentences.zh: 但即便在最恶劣天气下，也很少出现不出航的情况。

sentences.en: As well as going out on the lifeboat, my work involves other things too.
sentences.zh: 除驾驶救生艇出海外，我的工作还包括其他内容。

sentences.en: A lot of people underestimate how quickly conditions can change at sea, so I speak to youth groups and sailing clubs in the area about the sorts of problems that sailors and swimmers can have if the weather suddenly gets bad.
sentences.zh: 许多人严重低估了海上环境变化之快，因此我会向本地青年团体和帆船俱乐部讲解：一旦天气骤变，水手和游泳者可能遭遇哪些问题。

sentences.en: We also have a lot of volunteers who organise activities to raise money for us, and we couldn't manage without them.
sentences.zh: 我们还有大量志愿者负责组织筹款活动，没有他们，我们根本无法运转。

sentences.en: The training we get is a continuous process, focusing on technical competence and safe handling techniques, and it's given me the confidence to deal with extreme situations without /18 panicking.
sentences.zh: 我们接受的培训是一个持续过程，重点在于技术能力与安全操作技巧，这让我有信心在极端情况下保持冷静、不慌乱。

sentences.en: I was glad I'd done a first aid course before | started, as that's a big help with the casualty care activities we do.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸入职前已完成急救课程，这对开展伤员护理工作大有帮助。

sentences.en: We've done a lot on how to deal with ropes and tie knots - that's an essential skill.
sentences.zh: 我们在绳索操作与打结技巧方面进行了大量训练——这是必不可少的技能。

sentences.en: After a year, did a one-week residential course, led by specialists.
sentences.zh: 一年后，我参加了一周的集中住宿培训课程，由专家主讲。

sentences.en: They had a wave-tank where they could create extreme weather conditions - so we could get /18 experience at what to do if the boat turned over in a storm at night, for example.
sentences.zh: 他们设有造浪水池，可模拟极端天气条件——例如，让我们亲身体验夜间风暴中救生艇倾覆时该如何应对。

sentences.en: Audioscripts Since I started, I've had to deal with a range of emergency situations.
sentences.zh: 自加入以来，我已处理过多种紧急情况。

sentences.en: But the work's hugely motivating.
sentences.zh: 但这项工作极具激励性。

sentences.en: It's not just about saving lives - I've learned a lot about the technology involved.
sentences.zh: 它不仅关乎拯救生命——我还深入了解了其中涉及的各项技术。

sentences.en: My background in IT's been useful here, and can use my expertise to help other volunteers.
sentences.zh: 我在IT领域的背景在此很有帮助，我也能运用自身专长协助其他志愿者。

sentences.en: They're a great group - we're like a family really, which helps when /20 you're dragging yourself out of bed on a cold stormy night.
sentences.zh: 这群伙伴非常优秀——我们真像一家人，这在寒冷暴风雨夜被叫醒赶往现场时尤为珍贵。

sentences.en: But actually, it's the colder months that can be the most rewarding time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，反而是寒冷月份往往最具成就感。

sentences.en: That's when the incidents tend to be more serious, and you realise that you can make a huge difference to the outcome.
sentences.zh: 因为此时发生的事故通常更为严重，你更能真切体会到自己对最终结果所能产生的巨大影响。

sentences.en: So if any of you listeners are interested. . . .
sentences.zh: 所以，各位听众朋友，如果您对此感兴趣……
